newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arab League chief hails Algeria's referendum.
newsitem.headline: Arab League chief hails Algeria's referendum.

text.p: Cairo-based Arab League's Secretary General Esmat Abdel el Meguid telephoned Algerian President Liamine Zeroual on Friday to congratulate him on his victory in the referendum on constitutional change.

"The Arab League's Secretray General considered the huge turnout in the referendum has showed Algerians' political maturity and commitment to peace and stability," said Abdel el Meguid, quoted by the Algerian official news agency APS.
Thursday's referendum confirmed Algerians's wide support for Zeroual's political reforms, he added.
Algerians have voted overwhelmingly for Zeroual's draft constitution banning Islam-based political parties.
More than 60,000 people have been killed in Algeria's five years of violence pitting Moslem guerrillas against the government.
